summary: PASS 1 complete. Every non-match item from the prior measurement is now implemented and verified: topbar title/breadcrumb placeholders, the idle headline (rust glyph + "Ready on {workspace}"), the default composer pill (connection:workspace + ctx 0%), the three-region idle layout (scroll region -> composer dock -> animated spacer) that centers the composer pre-turn and slides it to the floor on send, the SUGGESTED block (label + 3 starter rows, click-to-fill), the ask toggle rendered unconditionally, and the +new dialog (container/tabs/fields/CREATE, including the workspace tab's path row). Two genuinely unbacked pieces are shown with the established visible-degraded marker rather than hidden or faked: the +new dialog's "browse…" OS file picker (no backend surface in web OR desktop yet), and the topbar breadcrumb's pre-attachment click target (the prototype routes to a blueprint PICKER inside Settings that does not exist in this app yet; clicking now opens the existing read-only blueprint window with an honest "not wired yet" empty state instead of doing nothing). PASS 3 (2026-08-05): re-verified all 19 items against the current tree (nothing else drifted since PASS 1/the PASS-2 audit). The one non-match item — the model selector's doubled 'model not set / model not set' the PASS-2 independent audit caught — is now fixed and re-verified live on THIS surface's own idle path (root cause was fixed by the composer-pill surface's own PASS-3 grind one pass earlier; this pass adds this surface's own regression lock rather than inheriting the fix on faith). All 19 items now match. Also hardened the shared side-by-side.mjs `fresh` setup, which was flaky against the real live backend: its app-side +new -> CREATE flow used a fixed ~1.2s timeout that under-waited the real POST /v1/sessions round-trip (observed 0.5s-4s+) and, separately, the follow-up GET /context/state that populates the composer pill's ctx% chip (a second, independently-timed live fetch) — both now wait on the actual DOM signal (dialog detached / ctx text present) instead of guessing a delay. The composite briefly showed the ctx chip vanishing after session creation before this fix; re-verified with the fix in place that this was a capture-timing artifact of the tool, not an app defect — refreshPill's real context/state response for a genuinely fresh session correctly carries pct_used:0.
